lede: Thanksgiving week is the whole story this week — Turkey Trot on Thursday morning, An Outlaw Thanksgiving at Alloy Kitchen, live music at Mountain Lodge, and the valley settling into that familiar holiday rhythm before the post-holiday ski crowds arrive. On the government side, the Open Space Commission and the Board of County Commissioners both have meetings scheduled, but agendas haven't been posted yet, so nothing to track down at the dais this week.
